in_sanskrit.name: कुटुम्बिनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The feminine form of 'Kutumba', which means family, clan, or group. 'Bini' is a diminutive suffix that means small or little, often used to denote affection. Thus, Kutumbini is the goddess of small or new families or clans.

in_marathi.name: Kutumbini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the family
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kutumbini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kutumbini is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'kutumba', which means 'family'. Kutumbini is the goddess of the family, protectress of the home, and giver of prosperity and happiness. She is invoked to ensure the well-being and harmony of the family.
